name: 部署 / 休眠与唤醒 / 引擎真实休眠、网关 503、L1/L2 唤醒后恢复推理
scope: Single targeted contract; not a full sleep/wake or dGPU completion claim
identity: admin browser; real agent/Docker; OpenAI-compatible inference key for the gateway
fixture: isolated server, fresh SQLite, unique runId, real Chrome, real agent over WS, real Docker daemon; GPU facts injected for scheduling only; engine is the audited fake-engine image; engine /is_sleeping read over the host network

execution_evidence.reason: The real engine reported /is_sleeping=true after both L1 and L2 orders and false after each wake. The container stayed running through L1. The gateway returned 503 while asleep and 200 with choices after both wakes.

crud.create: N/A: the deployment is created through the API as a fixture with sleepable=true; deployment creation is a separate contract
crud.read: covered: list row, drawer, independent GET instance state and engine /is_sleeping
crud.update: covered: L1 sleep → wake → L2 sleep → wake through the drawer with exact requests and observed engine/instance state
crud.delete: N/A: the fixture force-deletes the deployment in cleanup; deletion is covered by the deployment lifecycle contract
